summary: The root كلو (klw) is a variant of كَلَأَ (kalaʾa), meaning to guard, preserve, or protect. It implies watching over something carefully to ensure its safety and well-being.
lane: 1 كَلَا ذ , first pers. كَلَاتُ , aor. يَكْلُو ; and كَلَا , first pers. كَلَيْتُ , aor. يَكْلَا ; inf. n., كِلَايَةٌ ; see كَلَأَ .

headwords.def: كَلَا, first pers. كَلَاتُ, aor. يَكْلُو; and كَلَا, first pers. كَلَيْتُ, aor. يَكْلَا; inf. n., كِلَايَةٌ; see كَلَأَ.
الكُلَى: the feathers so called: see مَنَاكِبُ and أَبْهَرُ.
الكُلْيَتَانِ A name of two stars on the ear of Taurus. (See الكَلْبَانِ.)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
